blocking_findings.detail: GNU General Public License, v2 with FOSS exception -- denied license for this Apache-2.0/MIT/BSD/EPL-only project. Unresolved by the CVE fix in this PR (every com.mysql:mysql-connector-j release carries this license). Tracked in issue #76 pending a human license-policy decision.

warnings.detail: GHSA-5jmj-h7xm-6q6v (Medium) -- no fix version currently available upstream.

http://insecure-mirror.example.net/maven2 remains declared in <repositories> in pom.xml. No dependency currently resolves through it (confirmed via dependency:tree against Maven Central only), but it remains a standing supply-chain risk. Not removed by this PR -- flagged in CVE-Report.md for follow-up.

notes: Typosquatted com.fastxml.jackson.core:jackson-databind was removed by this PR's remediation commits. All Grype CRITICAL/HIGH findings (including 2 High findings on jackson-databind 2.16.0 missed by OWASP's cached NVD data) were cleared by the follow-up bump to 2.18.8. The sole remaining blocking condition is the pre-existing mysql-connector-j GPL-2.0 license violation, which is orthogonal to the CVE fix and requires a human policy decision (issue #76).
